title: Jyotish: a Sanatan panchang and jyotisha, computed and explained
description: Jyotish is a Sanatan panchang and jyotisha that runs offline in the browser and as a JavaScript library. It is the Kaivalyik projection of CHAKRA (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21253628) on a second-generation engine: VSOP87D planets, the ELP-2000 Moon, IAU 1980 nutation and Espenak and Meeus Delta-T, measured against an independent ephemeris from 1900 to 2100 (Sun within 0.5 arcsecond, planets within 5, Moon within 8, sunrise within 5 seconds). It computes the five limbs with their end times, the windows of the day, 37 observances dated by vyapti rules, a Shraddh calculator with the Pitru Paksha special days, the kundali with divisional charts, Vimshottari to five levels and doshas with their cancellations, Ashtakoota matching with a Monte Carlo over birth-time uncertainty, a muhurta finder, countdowns with calendar export and a just-intonation music of the orbs. Every rule is configuration with its sources, and every result explains its own working. Dedicated to Shri Jyotish Chandra Chaudhuri.
